fact: The National Road Transport Council chairperson announced on 2026-09-21 the rollout of BIKA, an official real-time platform where the public report corruption, abuse and other problems on public and freight transport, anonymously if wanted and tracked by a reference ID, with no case numbers given.

The Ministry of Health with UNICEF launched the Client Satisfaction and Feedback Mechanism on 1 June 2020, which prompts health clients for feedback on satisfaction, waiting time and other service variables; no case numbers are given.
